dataset_identity.title: Temperature and Humidity Time Series of Cold Storage Room Monitoring
dataset_identity.conference_citation: Towards Self-Adaptive Monitoring of Storage Environments with Distributed Sensor Systems, IEEE ACSOS-C 2025, pp. 85-90

physical_setup.facility: Cold Storage Room, Department of Food Informatics, University of Hohenheim
physical_setup.sensor_model: DHT22 Digital Temperature and Relative Humidity Sensor
physical_setup.microcontroller: Arduino Uno / Nano with SD Data Logger (temphum_logger.ino)

sensor_roles.SENSOR01: Fixed primary ambient temperature & humidity monitor
sensor_roles.SENSOR03: Fixed cold-room corner monitor (temporary power dropout observed)
sensor_roles.SENSOR05: Mobile sensor deployed during specific experiment phases
sensor_roles.SENSOR08: Fixed cooling unit / evaporator adjacent monitor

data_limitations_and_integrity_rules.ledger_fields: No inventory, total capacity, free capacity, inbound tonnage, outbound tonnage, or occupancy measurements are present in this physical environmental dataset.
data_limitations_and_integrity_rules.invariant_enforcement: C1 (Capacity Consistency) and C2 (Inventory Flow) MUST return NOT_APPLICABLE. They must never be fabricated, assumed, or marked as PASS/VIOLATED.
data_limitations_and_integrity_rules.environmental_bounds: C3 evaluates real temperature against documented cold-storage limits (1.0-7.0 deg C) and humidity (60.0-85.0% RH). Door-opening events produce physical thermal transients that are operational events, NOT cyberattacks.
